$comment: JLCPCB fee table for the Flamingo cost model. Every entry is {value, source, verified, date?, note?}. verified:true means the value was read from the cited JLCPCB help page with WebFetch on the given date. verified:false means it is an ESTIMATE: JLCPCB publishes no figure, or the figure was not confirmed on a help page. Estimates are flagged wherever they surface. Bare-board prices in particular come only from JLCPCB's quote calculator, which Flamingo never calls, so every bare-board number here is an estimate. Shipping, tax, duties and coupons are not modelled.

qtySteps.note: Order quantities the quote form offers, from memory. The form itself was not opened.

maxSize.note: 'Keeping individual PCB dimensions within 100mm x 100mm qualifies orders for standard low-cost prototyping rates'. Seen in a search-result summary of a blog post, not fetched from a help page.

2.note: 'A 2-layer FR-4 board at 100 x 100 mm starts at $2.00 for 5 pieces' (search-result summary). The 10-piece price is from memory.

6.note: No special offer assumed for 6-layer boards.

2.note: ESTIMATE. Fixed part of a non-promotional order, chosen so that 5 boards of 100 x 150 mm come to about $10.

4.note: ESTIMATE, fitted with the area rate to one published data point: 100 pcs of 100 x 100 mm 4-layer = $70.60 (search-result summary).

6.note: ESTIMATE with no data point behind it.

2.note: ESTIMATE. USD per square metre of ordered board, by total order area.

4.note: ESTIMATE, fitted to 100 pcs of 100 x 100 mm 4-layer = $70.60 (1 m2 at $50 plus the $20 fee).

6.note: ESTIMATE with no data point behind it.

perExtraDesign.note: ESTIMATE. The help page confirms the charge exists ('If there is more than 1 design in your file, an extra cost will be applied') but gives no amount; the amount appears only in the quote calculator.

rule.note: 'if the traces/silkscreen/solder mask in your PCB is different, as long as it can be separated, no matter by v-cut, millings, or drill holes, it will be regarded as different designs'. Designs divided only by silkscreen lines inside one rectangular outline are not charged.

smallBoardDeburring.note: '1.5cm-3cm on one side: the extra fee is $0.02/pcs'; 'smaller than 1.5cm on one side: the extra fee is $0.05/pcs'. Applied per ordered piece.

vcutSmallBoard.note: V-cut adds no fee of its own in any help article read on 2026-10-26. The one V-cut surcharge: 'For orders where the dimensions of single boards in the panel are less than 15mm on either side ... an extra charge for V-cut will be applied.' The amount appears only in an image on that page, so it is not modelled; panel_check warns instead (limits vcut.smallBoardSide).

setupFee.note: Economic PCBA places one side only.

feederLoading.note: 'Feeder Loading $3.07 Extend'. Charged once per unique extended part. The FAQ rounds it to '$3 per extended component'.

qtySteps.note: The range 2-50 is published (capabilities page); the steps inside it are from memory of the order form.

feederLoading.note: 'Feeder Loading $1.53 Basic/Extend': on Standard PCBA every unique part is charged, basic or extended.

qtySteps.note: The range 2-80000 is published (capabilities page); the steps are from memory of the order form.

manualJoint.note: Manual assembly, 1-10,000 joints. Applied to through-hole joints.

handSolderLabor.note: 'Hand-soldering Labor: $3.58 per order'. Applied once when the order has through-hole parts.

panelFee.note: 'Panel (Applicable when the number of panelized designs > 1) $8.21'. Applied once to an assembly order whose piece is a panel of more than one board.

attrition.note: ESTIMATE, used only for a part JLCPCB's parts library does not list. The library gives each listed part its own attrition (lossNumber, leastPatchNumber), which the cost model takes first. These three classes are the stand-in; 'extra' is added to the quantity used, and the billed quantity is never below 'minimum'.
